newsitem.title: THAILAND: PRESS DIGEST - Thai newspapers - Sept 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Thai newspapers - Sept 12.

text.p: - Coalition leaders say a Parliament dissolution is likely after next week's censure debate against the prime minister. (THE NATION)
- One in every hundred schood children in Thailand is using amphetamines and the number is on the rise, Public Health Minister Snoh Thienthong said. (THE NATION)
- Abbot of Buddhist temple has asked a parliamentary committee to update law that bans monks from acting as mediums or engaging in voodoo. (BANGKOK POST)
- Finance Minister Bodi Chunnananda has approved a proposal to set up a new 20 billion baht to shore up the stock market. (BANGKOK POST)
- State-run Government Savings Bank will set up a 10 billion baht fund to help stock investors who are forced by brokerages to sell their shares. (MANAGER)
- Kuwait Petroleum (Thailand) Co is keen to establish an oil refinery in Thailand by 2000. (BANGKOK POST)
- Deputy Prime Minister Amnuay Viravan has urged German-based BMW AG to establish a car production hub in Thailand. (THE NATION)
